description: This file contains helper functions for testing MAC test modes in a 5G NR simulation, including creation of test PDUs with BSR and RRC setup complete messages, and functions for generating and matching UCI PDUs with various formats.

methods.name: create_test_pdu_with_bsr
methods.description: Creates a test MAC PDU with a Buffer Status Report (BSR) indicating maximum size.

methods.name: create_test_pdu_with_rrc_setup_complete
methods.description: Creates a test MAC PDU with an RRC setup complete message.

methods.name: create_uci_pdu (pucch_info, test_ue_cfg)
methods.description: Generates a UCI PDU based on PUCCH info and test UE configuration.

methods.name: create_uci_pdu (ul_sched_info, test_ue_cfg)
methods.description: Generates a UCI PDU based on UL scheduled info and test UE configuration.

methods.name: pucch_info_and_uci_ind_match
methods.description: Checks if a given PUCCH info matches a UCI indication.
